 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><A NAME="fs171958_1"></A>FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Notice regarding </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Outcome of Tender Offer for Shares, etc. of Vantec Corporation </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>by
Subsidiary </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Tokyo, April&nbsp;20, 2011</B> &#151; Hitachi, Ltd. (NYSE: HIT / TSE: 6501; &#147;Hitachi&#148;) today announced the
outcome of tender offer for shares, etc. of Vantec Corporation (TSE:9382) by Hitachi Transport System Ltd. (TSE: 9086; &#147;the Company&#148;), a subsidiary of Hitachi. The Company announced acquiring shares, etc. of Vantec Corporation through a
tender offer (the &#147;Tender Offer&#148;) on March&nbsp;9, 2011 and commenced the Tender Offer from March&nbsp;10, 2011. As the Tender Offer was completed on April&nbsp;19, 2011, the Company hereby announced the outcome of the Tender Offer as
attached. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Hitachi, Ltd. </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi, Ltd., (NYSE: HIT / TSE: 6501), headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, is a leading global electronics company with approximately 360,000 employees
worldwide. Fiscal 2009 (ended March&nbsp;31, 2010) consolidated revenues totaled 8,968 billion yen ($96.4 billion). Hitachi will focus more than ever on the Social Innovation Business, which includes information and telecommunication systems, power
systems, environmental, industrial and transportation systems, and social and urban systems, as well as the sophisticated materials and key devices that support them. For more information on Hitachi, please visit the company&#146;s website at
<U>http://www.hitachi.com</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"># # # </FONT></P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">- 1 -
</FONT></P>

Human&nbsp;Resources&nbsp;&amp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Business Support Office</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:1px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(Tel: &#43;81-3-5634-0307)</FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Notification regarding </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Result of the Tender Offer of Shares, etc. of Vantec Corporation and </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Change in Subsidiary </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi Transport System, Ltd. (the &#147;Company&#148; or the &#147;Tender Offeror&#148;) resolved at its board of directors&#146; meeting held on March&nbsp;9, 2011, that it will acquire through tender
offer (the &#147;Tender Offer&#148;) (a)&nbsp;the common stock of Vantec Corporation (Code: 9382, First Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange) (the &#147;Target&#148;), and (b)&nbsp;the share options (the &#147;Share Option(s)&#148;) the issuance of
which was resolved at the shareholders&#146; meeting of the former Vantec Corporation (the former Vantec Corporation was subsequently dissolved as a result of an absorption-type merger with Vantec Group Holdings Corporation; hereinafter referred to
as the &#147;Former Vantec&#148;) held on June&nbsp;25, 2004, and the rights and obligations of which were succeeded by Vantec Holdings Corporation (the &#147;Vantec Holdings&#148;) through a share exchange with the Former Vantec on March&nbsp;25,
2005, and then succeeded by the Target through a share transfer undertaken by Vantec Holdings on March&nbsp;1, 2006, and commenced the Tender Offer from March&nbsp;10, 2011. The Tender Offeror hereby announces that the Tender Offer was completed on
April&nbsp;19, 2011, as set forth below. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Furthermore, the Company also announces that the Target is to become the
Company&#146;s consolidated subsidiary as of April&nbsp;26, 2011 (commencement date of settlement of the Tender Offer) as a result of the Tender Offer. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Note </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Result of the Tender Offer </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Outline of the Tender Offer, etc. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="4%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
